{{Top}}
{{Youmay|a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] classification|[[Interceptor (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|the Nebulon-B escort frigate ''Interceptor'']]}}
[[File:Eta-2_Interceptor.png|thumb|right|250px|A Jedi Interceptor.]]
'''Interceptors''' were fast and maneuverable [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. They were designed specifically to target, hunt down, and destroy enemy fighters and bombers, hence the name ''interceptor'', and thus were generally unsuited to carrying heavy bombing payloads. Interceptors could also be used for reconnaissance due to their high speed. During his campaign, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] noted the weakness in keeping fast interceptors close to a convoy for escort.
